title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 9 — WORLD 9: C1+ ARTS, CULTURE, MEDIA & HUMANITIES
grammar: Advanced critical and interpretive language for humanities and cultural analysis
Nuanced comparison, contrast, concession, and evaluation
Hedging and attribution when interpreting evidence and artistic meaning
Complex relative, participial, and reduced-clause structures
Modal language for interpretation, inference, and degrees of certainty
Rhetorical emphasis and stylistic variation in reviews and essays
Register adaptation for academic, journalistic, creative, and public audiences
